headline: Paraguay Arrests Eight Ueno Bank Executives Amid Liquidity Concerns
summary: A crisis at Ueno Bank in Paraguay led to the arrest of eight executives and the resignation of the central bank chief, raising concerns over depositor funds and pension assets totaling $380 million.
why: Banking sector crises and executive arrests trigger systemic liquidity concerns and heightened regulatory scrutiny over depositor and pension fund security.
